subject: Re: Status: repro done, variance wins hold, one scope boundary
body:
Team,

Decisions going into pilot month:

1. Pilot is GO for July. Privacy review cleared 6/24 with one condition - counterfactual queries run against a hashed snapshot, not live logs - which Emeka says costs us a day of plumbing. Acceptable.
2. Pilot scope: Gadget 2 only. Giannis's reruns show it dominating on the non-uniform mechanisms that actually occur in the decision system, and one gadget keeps Wei's July hours focused. Gadget 1 stays available in the API but out of the pilot report.
3. The audit report template will state the two-gadget scope boundary and cite the companion-repo limitation, per Giannis's note.
4. Review moves from 7/9 to 7/10 to avoid colliding with the portfolio all-hands.

Wei - the pilot is yours to run; everyone else protects your calendar. Let's find out if the variance numbers survive contact with a real audit question.

Ximena
